geology_notes: Triple F Gold Property, 851 ha, 28 km northwest of Kelowna, BC. Phase I exploration completed March 2026 identified gold-bearing quartz veinlets hosted by weakly altered volcanic agglomerate. Mineralized envelope estimated at approximately 300x250x250 m based on historic sampling patterns. No modern NI 43-101 technical report or resource estimate has been completed. The setting is plausible for low-sulphidation epithermal gold but Phase I results are descriptive only — no assay highlight or drill intercept has been released.

analyst_summary: Goldcana Resources is a 2023-vintage CSE micro-cap at the earliest possible stage of its exploration lifecycle on the Triple F Gold Property near Kelowna, BC. Phase I sampling confirms a 300x250x250 m gold-bearing zone, but no modern drilling or resource estimate exists and no drill program has been announced or funded. Management track record is undisclosed. The risk profile is too speculative for our framework until the company advances to a drill decision and publishes a Phase II technical report.
